'''Pikk Mukmuk''', also known as '''Muk Muk monkey''', was a [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]] who was a member of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The monkey-lizard was present with him during his [[Skirmish on Felucia/Legends|raids]] on [[Nysillin/Legends|Nysillin]] [[Akira/Legends|farms]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. He unsuccessfully attacked [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. He also knew how to drive a tank, and managed to kill [[Rumi Paramita/Legends|Rumi Paramita]] with a cannon blast.<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}}</ref> Pikk Mukmuk was the brother of [[Pilf Mukmuk/Legends|Pilf Mukmuk]], another monkey-lizard owned by Ohnaka's gang.<ref name=":1">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Kowakian monkey-lizard was voiced by [[Matt Lanter]], who also voices [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars TV series'']].<ref name=":0" /> The episode guide to ''Bounty Hunters'' lists the character's name as Muk Muk monkey, only slightly different in capitalization from [[Lee-Chee Mukmuk|Muk Muk Monkey]], the name of a Kowakian monkey-lizard featured in the ''Clone Wars'' episode ''[[Lightsaber Lost]]''.<ref>See {{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode211.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lightsaber Lost}} and {{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode217.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Bounty Hunters}}.</ref> The later sources ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''<ref name=":1" /> and ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' give his name instead as Pikk Mukmuk and make him the brother of Pilf.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref>
